entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
I need to return the VeloBand I bought.

I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number? And just to be sure I'm on the right track, is there a technical fault with the device, or is it more of a preference issue?
The name is Alex Sterling, order 774-B-91. It's not broken. I just changed my mind.
Thank you, Alex. I have your account pulled up. So, no specific issue with the tracking or features, you've just decided it's not the right fit for you?
Basically. It was an impulse buy and I just don't use it. So what's the process? Do I have to go through some annoying resale marketplace?

Oh, not at all! Let me just check the policy here. Okay, I see you received the VeloBand 18 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh. Fine. I expected a bigger hassle.

We try to make it as easy as possible, especially for our VIP members. I've just initiated the return for you. You'll receive a pre-paid shipping label in your email within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.

You certainly will. Once our warehouse receives the item, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. And as a small thank you for being a loyal VeloFit customer, I've also added a $15 credit to your account for any future purchases. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No. That's it. Send the email.
It's on its way now. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great day.
